nodes.label: Two Authoring Layers (Decorators vs Frozen Descriptors)
nodes.rationale: Decorators write reflect-metadata entries only; compileRootModule lowers classes into frozen descriptors so @aponiajs/core never imports reflect-metadata and hand-written descriptors remain fully supported.

nodes.label: One-Way Package Dependency Direction (common -> core -> platform-core -> platform)
nodes.rationale: Enforces runtime neutrality in common, core, and platform-core so no HTTP or Bun API leaks downward and platforms stay thin adapters.

nodes.label: Module Graph & Visibility Rules (compileModuleGraph / ModuleGraph.locate)
nodes.rationale: Validates duplicate module identity, import cycles, duplicate tokens, invalid exports, and unresolved dependencies eagerly at compile time; enforces export visibility and throws AMBIGUOUS_PROVIDER on conflicting imports while allowing diamonds.

nodes.label: ConfigurableModuleBuilder & moduleOptionsProviders
nodes.rationale: Provides immutable Nest-compatible dynamic module generation and a single shared async lowering (useFactory, useClass, useExisting) so plugin packages never duplicate async-options wiring.

nodes.label: Route Validation Contract (Standard Schema & TypeBox ValidatorSchema)
nodes.rationale: Uses one-schema-per-class @Validation models and structural ValidatorSchema matching so @aponiajs/common only needs typebox as a type-only dependency.

nodes.label: WebSocket Gateway Envelope & Provider-Based Lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Uses a documented { event, data } JSON envelope over native WebSockets and resolves gateway singletons through the module container rather than constructing a separate gateway container.

nodes.label: HandlerContext & definePlugin Type Projection
nodes.rationale: Explicitly links erased PluginModule imports into handler types without ambient declaration merging, which would leak across compilations.

nodes.label: AponiaError & RFC 9457 Problem Details HttpError
nodes.rationale: Uses a closed AponiaErrorCode union with frozen details for framework failures and RFC 9457 application/problem+json HttpError responses that never leak stacks or causes.

nodes.label: Explicit Platform Parity via requirePlatformCapabilities
nodes.rationale: Feature packages contribute runtime-neutral artifacts and declare required capabilities; boot rejects missing capabilities with UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM_FEATURE instead of shipping platform allowlists.

nodes.label: Domain-First Nest-Shaped Source Layout
nodes.rationale: Organizes package source under domain directories with one Nest kind suffix per file and builds from src/ rather than Nest's lib/.
